वाले पदधारियों को इन नियमों के प्रावधानों के अनुसार नियुक्त किया गया माना जाएगा और इन नियमों के प्रारंभ होने से 
पहले उक्त पद पर उनके द्वारा प्रदान की गई सेवाओं को परिवीक्षा की अवधि के उद्देश्य को तय करने और अगले उच्च ग्रेड में 
पदोन्नति के लिए पात्रता तय करने के लिए ध्यान में रखा जाएगा।

प्रवर्तन से छूट दे सकेगी।

बाबत, आदेश द्वारा शिथिल कर सकेगी। 
7. व्यावृत्ति.-इन नियमों की कोई बात, ऐसे आरक्षण, आयु-सीमा में छूट और अन्य रियायतों पर प्रभाव नहीं

3. भर्ती की पद्धति, आयु-सीमा, अर्हताएं, आदि : उक्त पद पर भर्ती की पद्धति, आयु-सीमा, अर्हताएं और उससे

RahulRagunathOvhal मम मम मम] Petitioner 
vs.

Mr. Akshay Shinde for respondent no. 2. 
Mr. Shekhar Jagtap a/w. Ms. Sairuchita Choudhary i/b. J. Shekhar Associates for respondent no. 3.

P.C. 
. The proceedings are listed in pursuance of a praecipe application as moved by Mr. Shinde, learned counsel for 


respondent no. 2. 


2. This election petition challenges the election of respondent no. 3 to the Lok Sabha from the Lok Sabha Constituency 
no. 36-Shirur, District Pune, in Parliamentary elections held in the year 20l9. Admittedly, the term of the Lok Sabha relevant 
to such election expired on 6 June, 2024. Thereafter, fresh elections were held in the month of May, 2024, the results of 
which were declared on 4 June, 2024, in which respondent no. 3 had again contested from the same constituency 
and is stated to have been re-elected to the Lok Sabha. It is, therefore, stated that the present proceedings have now 
becomeacademic/infructuous. 


3, It is on such backdrop respondent no. 2 has moved this Court by such application dated 9 June, 2024 setting out the 
urgency. It is stated that for the purpose of the present proceedings, respondent no. 2 had stored and secured 4622 Ballot 
units, 23!! Control Units and 7242 VVPAT machines, which are stored in a godown with police security. It is stated that 
now the State Assembly elections would be held in the month of November, 2024 and for such purpose, respondent no. 2 
requires the aforesaid materials. It is hence submitted that appropriate orders be passed considering that the petition has now 
become infructuous. 


4. Although the cause-list was notified listing the present proceeding, however, none represents the petitioner, and 
possibly in view of the fact thatthe petition itself has become infructuous. 


5. From the record it appears that on the last occasion, the Court had heard the proceedings on 4 March, 2020 on the 
Application (L) No. 3 of 209 filed by respondent no. l, which came to be allowed in terms of prayer clauses(a) and (b). 
Also, the proceedings were not moved by the advocate for the petitioner for any further orders to be passed on the 
proceedings and more particularly, considering the nature of the challenge as raised in regard to which observations have been 
made by the Court in order dated 4 March, 2020. 


6. In the aforesaid circumstances, as now the term of the Lok Sabha relevant to the 209 election and subject matter of 
the present proceedings itself has come to an end, as also fresh Lok Sabha elections were held in May, 2024, results of 
which being already declared, learned counsel for respondent no. 2 would be correct in submitting that the present proceedings 
have become infructuous. The petition is accordingly disposed of as infructuous.

7. Respondent no. 2 is hence free to use the Ballot units, Control Units and VVPAT machines as per the procedure 
followed by it for other elections,

कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार 
आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी 
अधिनियम, 2043 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय 
कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने

के खंड (क) और खंड (ख) के साथ पठित उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, असम राइफल्स (समूह “ग” 
योधक पद) भर्ती नियम, 2000 को, जहां तक उनका संबंध नायब सूबेदार (हिन्दी अनुवादक) के पद से है, उन बातों के सिवाय 
अधिकांत करते हुए, जिन्हें ऐसे अधिकमण से पूर्व किया गया है या करने का लोप किया गया है, गृह मंत्रालय में, असम राइफल्स 
में सूबेदार (हिन्दी अनुवादक) के पद पर भर्ती की पद्धति का विनियमन करने के लिए निम्नलिखित नियम बनाती हैं, अर्थातः-

The dispute under reference related to :- 


“क्या महासचिव रा ट्रीयकृत बैंक कर्मचारी wad द्वारा श्री गांगीलाल यादव सेवानिवृत्त ea, act

एुनरीक्षित वेतनमान समझौते की AT करना एक्स उपरोक्त अवधि की सेवा कॉल को जोड़कर सेवानिवृत्त लाथ की 
aT करना arated है ? यदि है तो श्री मांगीलाल यादव किस sar’ 7 के भागी है ?” 


After registering the case on the basis of the reference received, Notices were sent to the parties and were 
duly served on them. They appeared and filed their respective statements of claim and defense. 


In short, the admitted facts are that the workman was suspended on 13.012.1982 by management with 
respect to alleged misconduct. He remained suspended till 22.12.1993. A First Information Report was lodged by the 
Bank with local Police, against him on 21.12.1982 containing allegations of fraud, forgery and misappropriation. 
Charge-sheet under Section 420/467/468/381 IPC was filed by Police on the basis of investigation, which was 
registered on 13.04.1983. During trial of the case before the Court of Magistrate, the workman was reinstated by 
management on 22.12.1993. The workman was conducted by Court of Magistrate vide Judgment dated 17.03.2009 
for the charge of 420/467/468

S.O. 2174.—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 5 read with section 6 of the 
Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946, the Central Government with the consent of the State Government of 
Manipur, issued vide Notification No. H-1701/135/2024-HD-HD, Imphal the 9th August, 2024 Secretariat : Home 
Department, hereby extends the powers and jurisdiction of the members of the Delhi Special Police Establishment in 
the whole State of Manipur for investigation of the offences or classes of offences notified under section 3 of the Act, 
as amended from time to time, alleged to have been committed by employees of the Central Government, Central 
Public Sector Undertakings and Private persons (whether acting separately or in conjunction with the employees of 
the Central Government/Central Government Undertakings) subject, however, to the condition that no such 
investigation shall be taken up in cases relating to the public servants controlled by the State Government of Manipur 
except with the prior written permission of the State Government. All previous general consent for any other offences 
and consent accorded on case to case basis for any other offence by the State Government shall also remain in force.

सेना चिकित्सा सेवा महानिदेशालय, सशस्त्र सेना चिकित्सा सामग्री डिपो, भण्डार रक्षण कर्मचारी समूह 'ग” पद भर्ती 
नियम, 2006 को, जहां तक उनका संबंध भण्डार अधीक्षक के पद से है, उन बातों के सिवाय अधिक्रांत करते हुए, जिन्हें ऐसे 
अधिक्रमण से पहले किया गया है या करने का लोप किया गया है, रक्षा मंत्रालय, सशस्त्र सेना चिकित्सा सेवा महानिदेशालय 
के अधीन वरिष्ठ भण्डार अधीक्षक के पद पर भर्ती की पद्धति का विनियमन करने के लिए निम्नलिखित नियम बनाते है,

महानिदेशालय, वरिष्ठ भण्डार अधीक्षक (समूह 'ख' पद) भर्ती नियम, 2026 है। 
(2) ये राजपत्र में प्रकाशन की तारीख को प्रवृत होंगे। 


2: पद संख्या, वर्गीकरण और वेतन मैट्रिक्स में स्तर - उक्त पद की संख्या, उसका वर्गीकरण और वेतन सारणी में स्तर

3. भर्ती की पद्धति, आयु-सीमा, अर्हताएं आदि - उक्त पद पर भर्ती की पद्धति, आयु-सीमा, अर्हताएं और उससे 
संबंधित अन्य बातें वे होंगी जो उक्त अनुसूची के स्तंभ (5) से स्तंभ (13) में विनिर्दिष्ट हैं।
